text:
Jordan (oncall): OpsBot paged me for a flapping node impacting multi-GPU runs in tp4. GPU node gpu-12 showing repeated CUDA Xid=79 then container crash. :rotating_light:
OpsBot: INCIDENT ALERT - node=gpu-12 severity=high service=serving-runtime error=NCCL_COMM_TIMEOUT Xid=79 containers=3 restarts=2
Jordan (oncall): Observed in logs: `nccl: comm timeout, rank 1 failed to recv` then `CUDA error: Xid 79` and k8s restarted the container. Root request ts 1789456789.
Maya (serving): Noted. Traffic spike to model-prod-tp4? Any customer-facing 5xxs?
Sasha (ml-runtime): Yes, dashboards show increased 5xxs from the tp4 path, error-rate ~12% on the inference gateway for ~3m. Some runs timed out waiting on allreduce.
Lee (infra): Node gpu-12 has transient PCI errors in dmesg, NVLink flaps visible. Host reported driver oops earlier. Likely hardware/driver causing communicator to break.
Jordan (oncall): Quick mitigations: 1) drain node from k8s, 2) failover affected pods to same AZ, 3) set NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 where possible, 4) fallback to 1-GPU variant for high-p99 latency customers.
Maya (serving): I'm going to start a rollback to the 1-GPU variant for canary customers and enable route fallback. Can someone run the drain?
Lee (infra): Running drain now:```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
DeployBot: Rollout triggered: route-fallback-to-1g-1789456820 by Maya. Status: in-progress.
Jordan (oncall): Also adding NCCL env tweaks for pod spec temporarily: `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1`, `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS` and lowering `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` to limit to eth0. Sasha can you push a quick patch to the serving deployment?
Sasha (ml-runtime): Pushing patch to canary now. Patch snippet:
```yaml
- name: NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING
  value: "1"
- name: NCCL_P2P_LEVEL
  value: "SYS"
```
Sasha (ml-runtime): Canary pods came up with env changes, started warmup, KV cache warm. Monitoring NCCL errors.
OpsBot: Observability update - gateway 5xxs down from 12% to 3% after route-fallback and canary.
Maya (serving): Good. Are there any customer incidents? CS?
Customer Success (CS): We have 2 open tickets from customers A & B reporting inference failures ~10:12-10:16. We informed them we're investigating and have a mitigation. Will update them proactively.
Jordan (oncall): Handing over active incident to Maya for next steps and postmortem. @Maya you're oncall to drive the remediation and long-term fix. I'm going to rotate off but will stay available.
Maya (serving): Taking over. Quick checklist: 1) keep node cordoned and scheduled for maintenance, 2) validate driver/kernel versions across cluster, 3) run hardware tests on gpu-12, 4) schedule live fix window if hardware confirmed.
Lee (infra): Capturing host logs and submitting a ticket to HW vendor. Collected dmesg, nv_peer_mem logs, and crashkernel dump.
Sasha (ml-runtime): We'll also add a defensive change to the serving runtime to detect repeated Xid79 / NCCL_COMM_TIMEOUT and fallback to single-GPU execution automatically (short-term hotfix).
Jordan (oncall): Marking this as handoff: incident_status=mitigated routing=fallback applied, node cordoned, canary env patch applied.
DeployBot: route-fallback-to-1g-1789456820 completed. Canary=passed, rollout=100%.
Maya (serving): Observability shows latency and error rates back to baseline for tp4. Will keep cordon until infra gives all clear.
OpsBot: Summary metrics: 10:12-10:18 increased 5xx & NCCL errors, 10:18 mitigations applied, 10:21 error-rate normalized.
Customer Success (CS): I've sent proactive notifications to affected customers and created follow-up tasks.
Lee (infra): Hardware team scheduled on-site check for gpu-12 and neighbor nodes for Friday. Temporary mitigation: hardware isolation and driver reflash if reproducible.
Maya (serving): Thanks team. I'll create a formal incident report and assign action items: infra to root-cause hardware/driver, runtime to implement Xid79 auto-fallback + better KV-cache warmup, and docs to add playbook steps for node flap.
Jordan (oncall): Adding :white_check_mark: to handoff. If anything regresses, re-open pager.
Sasha (ml-runtime): Logged a follow-up GH issue: RN-issue-4321 "auto-fallback on NCCL Xid79".
Maya (serving): Closing handoff. Will post incident RCA draft by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
